mirrors.title: Mirrors of external systems
mirrors.about: Confluence and Jira are exported into Sources/ by deterministic scripts. A mirror is an object of work, not knowledge: cards refer to it through source:.
mirrors.pick_project: Pick a project on the Bridge.
mirrors.none: No mirrors are connected. Pick the modules below — their folders will appear in Sources/.
mirrors.sources_empty: Neither Sources/ nor Raw/ has any documents — the base has nothing to be built from.
mirrors.parsed_hint: Share of source documents that already produced cards
mirrors.modules_about: Checked modules fill their folders in Sources/. Unchecking one leaves the folder on disk (the panel never deletes data) but makes it nobody's: doctor will say so. The folder of a new mirror is created by an engine update.
mirrors.saved: The list of mirrors is saved in aurora.config.yaml
mirrors.no_env: There is no .env.aurora.local file — sync will not work. Template: aurora.env.local.example, it needs CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN and JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN (the same ones as in mcp-atlassian).
